diagnosis.text: DIAGNOSIS: The BACK+re-entry cycle after round 2 caused a false-positive double-match on re-entry (round 4 found 2 badges where only 1 was genuinely claimable), inflating `expected` from 3 to 4 and consuming one of the 3 `max_taps` slots on a phantom tap; when the real remaining badge was found in round 6, `total_tapped` had already reached the `max_taps=3` cap and the loop exited — leaving 1 claimable badge unclaimed as confirmed by the screenshot showing "Tap to Claim >" still present alongside only 2 cooldown timers.
